assignments.decisiveDefect: Two independent committed records agree that these two tracks have eight components between them; the packet delivers five, of which two carry identifiers neither record declares. Five required components are missing, three of them the guidance components that exist to set a participant's expectations before they spend money on an agency route that is refused on three common discretionary grounds. Separately, the non-conviction deletion page - a route the repository records four ways as having no court in it - is drafted as a court pleading that asks a court for relief.

COMPONENT_SET.measuredDetail: data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json packetSet.components and data/record-clearing/legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json agree, componentId for componentId, order for order: wa_vac_post_probation_9_95_240-set has 1 primary-filing-1, 2 proposed-order-2, 3 records-checklist-3, 4 filing-instructions-4, all required; wa_del_nonconviction-set has 1 primary-filing-1, 2 records-checklist-2, 3 expectation-setting-3, 4 accuracy-remedy-guidance-4, all required. The delivered componentSet in reports/rendered-artifacts.json is wa_vac_post_probation_9_95_240-primary-filing-1, wa_vac_post_probation_9_95_240-proposed-order-2, wa_vac_post_probation_9_95_240-filing-instructions-3, wa_del_nonconviction-primary-filing-1, wa_del_nonconviction-filing-instructions-2 - confirmed page by page across the 12 delivered pages. Missing and required: wa_vac_post_probation_9_95_240-records-checklist-3; wa_vac_post_probation_9_95_240-filing-instructions-4 (delivered under the undeclared id ...-filing-instructions-3, occupying the records checklist's ordinal); wa_del_nonconviction-records-checklist-2; wa_del_nonconviction-expectation-setting-3; wa_del_nonconviction-accuracy-remedy-guidance-4 (with wa_del_nonconviction-filing-instructions-2 delivered in its place, an id in neither record).
COMPONENT_SET.whatRepairMustDo: Build the five missing components and give the two delivered guidance pages the identifiers the records declare. The three wa_del guidance components are the ones to build first and are not interchangeable with each other: the records checklist is where the participant learns they need the WSP NON-conviction record (fingerprint card plus $12, or a no-fee in-person review) rather than the $11 WATCH check; expectation setting is where they learn, before paying, that WashingtonLawHelp says it is hard for information to qualify as non-conviction data; accuracy-remedy guidance is the RCW 10.97.040 and RCW 10.97.110 fallback for when the agency refuses. Some of that text is currently compressed into the misnamed filing-instructions page, which is why nothing reads as blank - but a compressed page is not four components and the record requires four.
COMPONENT_SET.whyNoCounterCaughtIt: requiredComponentsMissing recomputed 0. It is computed over the family's own field map, which describes the five components the build made; it cannot see three it never made because nothing in the family's own records mentions them. The counter is measuring the build against itself. Same shape as UNCLASSIFIED_BLANKS_BLIND_SPOT, on a different counter.

FILING_DESTINATION.measuredDetail: The repository records four ways that the wa_del_nonconviction route has no court in it: the census destination is {kind: agency, name: Washington State Patrol, detail: "...No court is involved and no order is sought. The agency decides..."}; the track registry venue is "Not a court route. The request goes to the Washington State Patrol"; rules.filing is "Submit the request to the Washington State Patrol... no court is involved"; rules.service is "none. The request is submitted to the WSP." The delivered packet page 8 nevertheless prints the caption "IN THE ............ COURT", the sub-caption "Case number, if the court assigns one at filing:", and the operative sentence "The petitioner, Jordan Avery Reyes, applies to this court under RCW 10.97.060; RCW 10.97.030(2); RCW 10.97.040; RCW 10.97.110 and states:". Page 10 section D prints "The petitioner asks the court to grant the relief described in paragraph A". Six lines below "applies to this court", the same page 8 prints, quoting the record, "The request goes to the Washington State Patrol rather than to a court: it is an agency request, not a petition." Page 11 prints "No court is involved and no order is sought" and "Venue: Not a court route." The participant is told both things inside one document.
FILING_DESTINATION.whatRepairMustDo: Redraft the wa_del_nonconviction primary filing as the agency request it is: address it to the Washington State Patrol, drop the court caption and the case-number-at-filing line, and replace "applies to this court" and "asks the court to grant the relief" with the request the record describes. The caption's parenthetical already names the right office, so the destination is discoverable - what has to change is the instrument. Check the same composed-pleading template wherever else an agency route uses it; this lane did not survey other families.
